Power (2014)
Power (2014) is a crime drama series starring Omari Hardwick as James “Ghost” St. Patrick, a powerful New York nightclub owner who secretly runs one of the city's largest drug operations. To the outside world, Ghost appears to have everything—a successful business, money, a beautiful family, and influence. But behind that lifestyle is a dangerous criminal empire that could collapse at any moment.
Ghost dreams of leaving the drug world behind and becoming a legitimate businessman. His nightclub represents the future he wants, but walking away from the organization that made him wealthy isn't as simple as he imagined. His longtime best friend and business partner, Tommy Egan, still sees the drug business as their path to power, creating tension between them.
Ghost's situation becomes even more complicated when Angela Valdes, a woman from his past, returns to his life as a federal prosecutor investigating the very organization he is trying to escape. Ghost must balance his criminal empire, his family, his relationship with Angela, and his desire for a legitimate future while keeping his secrets hidden.
The series explores themes of ambition, loyalty, betrayal, family, power, identity, greed, and the consequences of trying to live two completely different lives. Ghost wants to become a better man, but the decisions he made to gain his wealth continue to follow him.
What makes Power so addictive is its constant tension between Ghost's dream of becoming legitimate and the criminal world that refuses to let him go. Every alliance can become a betrayal, and every secret can become a weapon.
More than just a crime series, Power is about the price of ambition. Ghost spends his life trying to build a better future, but the higher he climbs, the more dangerous it becomes to protect everything he has created.
💬 If you were Ghost, would you leave the streets behind or keep the power you already built?
